metadata.description: ipscout delivered as a single Claude Code plugin: a skill for probing network reachability and inspecting the local network from Python or the shell, in-process and without administrator rights.

plugins.name: ipscout
plugins.description: Ping, sweep, traceroute, port scan, banner grab, SNMP system read, neighbour-cache lookup and static writes, interface enumeration and DHCP observation from Python or the CLI, without a subprocess and mostly unprivileged. Covers the library API, the JSON output for machine consumers, and the platform limits measured on Linux, macOS and Windows.
